REVIVETHESPIRE-ACCRETION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to damage dealt.
REVIVETHESPIRE-ACCRETION.title: Accretion

REVIVETHESPIRE-AGGREGATE.title: Aggregate

Every 2 times you lose HP, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
REVIVETHESPIRE-BRUTALITY.title: Brutality

REVIVETHESPIRE-COALESCE.title: Coalesce

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

{IfUpgraded:show:Your next [gold]{ResorptionPower:plural:Summon|{ResorptionPower:diff()} Summons}[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] gained from cards {ResorptionPower:plural:is|are} doubled.

Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
